item.tib: tshe sgrub ye shes gra gur las tshe glu snang ba'i dpal gter 'od dkar g.yo ba'i 'dzum phreng
item.coloph: ces 'chi med tshe yi sgrab pa las tshe glu 'jigs med snang ba'i dpal gter 'od dkar g.yo ba'i 'dzum phreng 'di yang / bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgon po tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying bu/ grub pa'i dbang po rig 'dzin yongs kyi khyu mchog gsang grub sems dpa' lnga yi nang nas sha ri dbu chen u rgyan rjes 'breng nyer lnga'i nang nas dbang gi grags pa/ rtsod ldan zhing gi mgon po smon lam g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de nyid kyi bka' slob skyabs gur du tshud pa'i zob po rlung khyer tha shal ba/ rgod rje'i gdung la dal rten rnyed pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying pos shar grol smin gling du thos shar du smras pa 'dis kyang de de bzhin du rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig//
